tab.revoked: Consent revoked: "{name}" can no longer be selected or spoken.
tab.deleted: Deleted "{name}": {remote, select, deleted {voice model deleted at the provider} failed {the voice model could not be deleted at the provider ({note})} other {library voice, nothing to remove at the provider}}; {count, plural, one {# reference recording(s) removed} other {# reference recording(s) removed}}.
tab.title: Voices
tab.intro: The voices a Voiceover step can narrate in. A cloned voice is a real person's voice: it needs their recorded consent, it expires on its retention date, and deleting it removes the voice model and the recordings it was made from.
tab.emptyBody: Add a provider voice by its id, or clone a voice from this project's own recordings, with the speaker's consent.
tab.emptyBadge: Provider default voice is used until then
tab.notAPerson: Not a person in this project
tab.revokeMessage: "{name}" will no longer be selectable or spoken anywhere in this project. The attestation stays on record; the voice itself is deleted after {days} days or when you delete it.
tab.deleteClonedMessage: This deletes the voice model at the provider, the {count, plural, one {# recording(s)} other {# recording(s)}} it was cloned from, and the voice itself. This cannot be undone.
tab.deleteLibraryMessage: This removes "{name}" from the project's library. The provider's own voice is not affected.

clone.title: Clone a voice
clone.biometricTitle: This is a person's biometric data
clone.biometricBody: The recordings you pick are sent to the speech provider to build a private voice model. Only clone a voice whose owner has given informed consent, and keep your own record of it. You can revoke consent or delete the voice at any time.
clone.referencesHint: Audio or video files already in this project. Clean speech, ideally 15 seconds or more in total.
clone.noMedia: No audio or video files in this project yet
clone.speechModelHint: Only Fish Audio models can clone. Blank uses the default speech model.
clone.keepForHint: The voice and its provider model are deleted automatically after this many days (max {max}).
clone.attest: I attest to the statement above. My user id and the time are recorded with this voice.

library.title: Add a library voice
library.intro: A voice the provider already offers, referenced by its id: a Fish Audio library reference id, or an OpenAI-compatible server's voice name such as af_heart or alloy.
library.name: Name
library.descriptionHint: Used by voice casting to pick between voices, e.g. warm and low, bright and quick.
library.speechModelHint: Blank uses the default speech model.

browser.notSupported: The speech model for this project has no voice library to browse. Add a voice by its id instead.
browser.loadFailed: Could not load the voice library.
browser.title: Browse voices
browser.intro: Voices the speech provider already offers. Adding one makes it available to Voiceover steps in this project; it is not a clone and needs no consent.
browser.searchPlaceholder: Name or style, e.g. calm narrator
